wuming-player additional third-party notices

Cling 2.1.2 / Seamless 1.1.2, copyright 4th Line GmbH and named source authors.
LGPL-2.1-or-later option selected. Complete notices: Cling-LICENSE.txt and
Seamless-LICENSE.txt. Source is included under vendor/ in the matching source
snapshot, including documented local transport and callback-security patches.

JavaScript bundles: package notices under javascript/; exact versions and npm
archive integrity in tools/js-bundle/package-lock.json in the source snapshot.

Maven dependencies: component notices under maven/ and the matching source
snapshot's docs/public-maven-inventory.json. Shared Apache and MPL texts included.
NewPipeExtractor GPL-3.0 and Rhino MPL-2.0 matching sources accompany that snapshot
under third_party/corresponding-source/. Preserve source access with binary releases.

Bundled catalog link (movie not bundled or modified): Big Buck Bunny (2008),
Copyright Blender Foundation / www.bigbuckbunny.org. Creative Commons Attribution
3.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/
Origin/license: https://peach.blender.org/about/

Application icons, home tiles, wallpapers, test patterns and tones were authored
for wuming-player. Source recipes and origins are recorded under artwork/ and
test-fixtures/ in the matching GPL-3.0 source snapshot.

Embedded native libraries: QuickJS (copyright 2017-2021 Fabrice Bellard and Charlie
Gordon, MIT), GIFLib/SKIA (full combined notices in android-gif-drawable-LICENSE.txt),
and librtmp (Team XBMC, Andrej Stepanchuk and Howard Chu, LGPL-2.1-or-later).
The RTMP wrapper is Apache-2.0; its librtmp sources and build files accompany the
matching snapshot under third_party/corresponding-source/. Its pinned build disables
crypto. NDK libc++ full license and legacy notices are also included here.

jQuery 3.7.1: Copyright OpenJS Foundation and other contributors, MIT; see
jQuery-LICENSE.txt. The bundled minified script matches the official distribution.
The original empty-state W/dot animation is GPL-3.0 project artwork.
